### [Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX](https://openai.com/index/our-decision-on-cursor-following-its-acquisition-by-spacex)

**OpenAI** · 2026-08-28

OpenAI is winding down its contract to supply AI models to the Cursor code editor following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX.

- OpenAI decided to terminate its model-provisioning contract with Cursor.
- The decision directly follows the acquisition of Cursor by SpaceX.

**Why it matters:** Cursor will no longer have direct access to OpenAI models under its existing contract due to the change in ownership.

### [Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups](https://openai.com/index/supporting-next-generation-ai-startups-thailand)

**OpenAI** · 2026-08-28

OpenAI and Thailand's MHESI have launched an eight-week accelerator program to help ten local health, wellness, and education startups develop AI prototypes into products.

- Joint initiative between OpenAI and Thailand's Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MHESI).
- Focuses on eight weeks of acceleration for ten selected startups.
- Target sectors are limited to health, wellness, and education.

**Why it matters:** The initiative provides direct industry support to transition early-stage Thai AI prototypes in key public sectors into deployable market products.
